products.description: Our Toddler’s Full-Zip Hoodie Top with 50+ UPF makes sun protection easy. Studies show that childhood sunburn increases the risk of skin cancer in adulthood. This long-sleeve, full-zip hoodie can be worn alone, as a base layer, sun shirt, swim shirt, rash guard, or beach cover-up. Lightweight and comfy, it's perfect for swimming, fishing, boating, tennis, and playtime. Crafted with BloqTek fabrics that are recommended by The Skin Cancer Foundation.
